changes: Charge script bytes as reads complete, including oversized bodies and partial transport failures
Preserve exact-limit responses with one look-ahead byte
Use a five-second per-script deadline under the existing page deadline
Record script timeouts without abandoning normal page references; user cancellation still propagates
limitations: One look-ahead byte may be read beyond the aggregate budget to detect overflow
Slow scripts may be skipped during discovery and still downloaded normally if selected
